title: Audit PR 211 KSHIP mass-energy, White-Hole burn attestation, ship authority, and KGOD stacked lineage without importing protected effects
reason: PR 211 is stacked on held PR 201 and expands a stated Product 06 idea into a 30-path rewrite of Product 05 contracts, documentation, tests, workflows, compile evidence, and indexes. Its production burn verifier cannot itself prove that the signed transaction hash and log index identify an actual KGEN burn, it hardcodes self-match and wash-trade flags false without the data needed to establish those facts, its matter scale is constructor-selected and tested at 1:1 despite current Canon requiring 1 KGEN equals 1,000,000,000 KSHIP by mass accounting, and its reactor accepts caller-selected allocation values that prove only arithmetic equality rather than authorized physical or economic conversion. Current main classifies KUFO and KSHIP production systems as not deployed and future. The safe action is an evidence-only audit. No candidate path is transplanted and PR 212 remains blocked.

inventory.selected_runtime_defect: The White-Hole verifier accepts dual-signed caller-supplied transactionHash and logIndex coordinates but cannot verify receipt-log inclusion or actual burn event semantics; the exact-head test deliberately uses a synthetic logIndex unrelated to the receipt.
inventory.security_blocker: Two configured attestors can create positive-matter credit from signed metadata without an on-chain receipt/log proof, while registrar, controller, registry, scale, burn, KGOD mint, and deployment authority remain unverified and protected.

blocking_findings: PR 211 is open, Draft, unmerged, stacked directly on held PR 201, and diverged from exact latest main by 59 commits ahead and 241 behind.

The relative stacked diff contains 30 paths rather than a narrow Product 06 successor. It rewrites Product 05 furnace, KUFO, KSHIP, wormhole, converter, documents, tests, workflows and compile tooling, and removes three V4-named Product 05 source paths.

Parent PR 201 remains held for unsolicited lineage-lot dusting that can push a victim past the 64-lot traversal ceiling and make full-balance transfers fail. PR 211 preserves the 65-lot fail-closed behavior and cannot bypass the parent defect.

KGENWhiteHoleBurnVerifier receives transactionHash, blockNumber, blockHash and logIndex from the submitter and validates two signatures plus a recent blockhash, but the EVM contract does not verify that the transaction is in that block or that the referenced log is a KGEN burn event.

The exact-head integration test derives logIndex from a keccak hash modulo one million instead of reading the transaction receipt log index. This proves the accepted coordinate need not identify a real receipt log.

The production verifier stores selfMatch=false and washTrade=false for every accepted proof. Its evidence contains no counterparty, swap direction, reserve delta or trade graph, so those safety facts are not established. The self-match and wash-trade rejection test uses a mutable mock verifier rather than the production verifier.

burnedKgen is recomputed from caller-supplied grossTradeKgen and the live TAX_BPS_BURN value at submission time, not bound to the actual historical transfer amount, burn Transfer event, totalSupply delta, or tax policy effective at the claimed block.

matterPerKgenNumerator and matterPerKgenDenominator are arbitrary immutable constructor inputs. Exact-head tests use 1:1, while current mass Canon states 1 KGEN equals one metric ton and 1 KSHIP equals one milligram, requiring 1 KGEN equals 1,000,000,000 KSHIP units for mass-preserving conversion.

K108000MassEnergyReactor lets a ship controller select propulsion, recoverable-energy, KGOD and radiation/heat allocation values. It checks that they sum to twice the KSHIP amount, but supplies no unit conversion, c-squared bridge, efficiency policy, oracle, bounded allocation policy or Canon-authorized KGOD ratio.

KAIOSShipIdentityRegistry gives one immutable registrar unilateral power to register arbitrary controller, trading-engine and reactor tuples and deactivate ships. It has no controller acceptance proof, transfer, recovery, delayed governance or multisig/quorum boundary.

KSHIP burn, positive-matter consumption and KGOD mint are real protected token effects if deployed. Green tests do not authorize deployment, approvals, registry proposals, signer use, controller registration or Mainnet execution.
Current main records the deployed 18911 V1 furnace as history and classifies 511111 KUFO and KSHIP production systems as NOT_DEPLOYED / FUTURE. The candidate cannot replace those facts.

The candidate compile tool remains divergent from the current-main frozen TempleHeart V3.3.2 regression baseline and the branch uses checkout/setup-node v4 workflows with only the historical K108000 and KUFO suites.

Repository-owner comments, read-only BSC observations and exact-head CI are engineering evidence, not attestor identity, registrar authority, controller consent, deployment receipt, governance approval or Human transaction authorization.
positive_findings: The candidate uses an append-only shared replay registry across verifier versions and rejects reuse of the same burn coordinate.
KGOD binds its reaction source immutably, K108000MassEnergyReactor uses a reentrancy guard, and KSHIP burning requires holder allowance.
Reaction records bind ship, owner, beneficiary and proof identifiers, and the arithmetic conservation sum is checked before state changes.
The unsigned deployment plan remains fail-closed with null candidate addresses, chainWriteAuthorized=false and signerUseAuthorized=false.
Historical exact-head K108000 and KUFO workflows succeeded at d1c823b2b8f465d9bae1994824f1f2db52c65128.
safe_successor_requirements: Start from exact latest main on a non-codex branch and limit changes to a bounded Product 06 successor; do not rewrite or delete held Product 05 paths.
Resolve PR 201 token-liveness and scope blockers before any Product 06 child can advance, and keep PR 212 Draft and unmerged.
Replace metadata-only burn attestation with an explicitly governed, domain-separated and independently verifiable receipt/log provenance design, or keep all positive-matter credit simulation-only.

Bind transaction hash, actual receipt log index, KGEN contract, pair, trader, transfer/burn amount, supply delta and effective tax policy to one canonical proof. Do not hardcode self-match or wash-trade status.
Fix the KGEN-to-KSHIP matter scale from current Canon or obtain an explicit protected Canon decision; add dimensional tests showing 1 KGEN equals 1,000,000,000 KSHIP mass units where applicable.
Define authorized units and bounded policies for propulsion, recoverable energy, KGOD material and radiation/heat; arithmetic equality alone is not physical or economic authorization.
Require machine-verifiable registrar authority, controller acceptance, recovery/transfer semantics, delayed governance and revocation evidence before registering any ship identity.
Preserve current compiler baselines and run current compile, workflow-security, native-market, Universal, Game and Responsive suites at the exact successor head.
Do not deploy, approve, burn, mint, transfer, appoint, attest, sign, propose registry changes, dispatch workflows, pay, govern, launch an agent or mutate chain state as part of this audit.
